name: io.github.aks129/healthclaw-guardrails
description: Guardrailed FHIR access for AI agents: PHI redaction, audit trail, step-up auth, tenant isolation

headers.description: Deployment-scoped bearer credential, required on every request — this endpoint returns 401 without it. Issued by the operator; not self-serve. For a keyless trial use the demo remote listed first, which is hard-pinned to a synthetic tenant.
headers.name: Authorization

headers.description: Tenant-bound HMAC step-up token, required for write-tier tools and non-public tenant reads
headers.name: X-Step-Up-Token
